text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's way past our slotted time for training, and Agnes Tachyon still hasn't shown up. Guess I should just go home.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, I'll use the concoction I'm currently testing with the other experiment…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh! That would allow me to validate that other research project at the same time… That's right, while I'm at it, there's still…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Trainer! Why didn't you come and get me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's because of you that it's already night! All the experiments I wanted to conduct today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She was so engrossed in her preparations, she lost track of time. I give her a tiny lecture, and though she sulks, she seems to reflect on the situation well enough.
